description: Auto-bump pins so exact versions never rot: GitHub Actions (@v1 pins incl. semver-calver-release), the Gatus docker image pinned inside scripts/010-provision.sh, and the OpenTofu version pinned in .opentofu-version (both via regex custom managers). Minor/patch bumps automerge once CI is green; MAJOR bumps always land as PRs for human review. Exception (M4): netcup-touching paths never automerge — they queue under the netcup-touching label as one batch PR (one approval per batch), via the packageRule below (placed after the automerge rule so it wins on overlap). The .opentofu-version bump stays auto-apply: CI-plane toolchain, inert until dispatch. Requires the Renovate GitHub App installed on this repo. Note: hosted-app commits are unsigned (signing is self-hosted-only), but squash merges produce GitHub web-flow-signed commits on main, so required_signatures holds; if platformAutomerge ever trips on the signature check, add renovate[bot] to the main-ruleset bypass list.

customManagers.description: Gatus docker image pinned in the provisioning script

packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor and patch bumps (Gatus image, action pins, tofu patch) once CI is green
Netcup-touching bumps queue under one label as one batch PR (one approval per batch); never automerge — they only take effect at dispatch
